part.text: Build passes with all routes rendering as expected. Migration complete:

Migration complete. `pages/` is deleted; everything now lives in `app/` with full TypeScript types. `tsc --noEmit` and `next build` both pass.

**API replacements:**
- `_app.js`/`_document.js` → `app/layout.tsx` (`metadata` export for description/favicon, font `<link>`s hoisted by React, `AppProvider` wraps `children`)
- `next/head` → `metadata` export / `generateMetadata` (dynamic title/description on `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`)
- `getServerSideProps` → async Server Component + `await headers()` in `app/page.tsx` (renders dynamically, ƒ)
- `getStaticProps` + `revalidate: 60` → `export const revalidate = 60` in `app/blog/page.tsx`
- `getStaticPaths` + `fallback: 'blocking'` → `generateStaticParams` + `dynamicParams = true` in `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`; `notFound: true` → `notFound()`; `router.isFallback` removed (blocking is automatic)
- `next/router` → `next/navigation` in client components (`ViewAllPostsButton`, `ReadMoreButton`, `BackButton`, `GoHomeButton`)
- `404.js`/`_error.js` → `app/not-found.tsx` and `app/error.tsx` (with `reset()`)
- API routes → route handlers: `app/api/posts/route.ts` (`GET`/`POST`) and `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (`GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE`) using `NextResponse`, `await request.json()`, and async `params: Promise<{ id: string }>`; manual 405/`Allow` handling dropped (framework handles it)

Build output confirms parity: `/` dynamic, `/blog` static (1m revalidate), `/blog/[id]` SSG with 10 paths (5m revalidate).
